statement_plain: Taking half at +1R and trailing the rest beats other exit rules on perps
question: Does 'take some, hold some toward the runners' beat other exits?
status_qualifier: EXPLORATORY (laptop M1, 9cd7c4d5): leads at all 5 stop widths on 177 coins x 400 random entries vs a martingale control, but best cell z 3.19 ~ the Bonferroni line over 70 cells, ORIG17/NEW156 disagree in sign at K=1.0/1.5, size 0.01-0.03R (about one round-trip of fees), 1h bars only. Trail flavour doesn't matter - the gain is the partial. Sealed prereg next. SEALED 10-13 (e0018cf1, PREREG_PARTIAL_EXIT): partial_1R_har vs stop_only at K=1.65 only, minus the M1 martingale control. Arm A = bot + owner-plan real entries (~300 closes, likely underpowered: MDE>25 bps -> UNDERPOWERED); Arm B = forward random entries on 1h bars after 2026-10-13, reads at >=30 forward days or 2026-12-01. NEW156 is spent (seen in M1). 5m referee agreed 99.4-99.8%. AMENDED 10-15 (f78d47b3, e0018cf1 -> e0621993): ATR-trail arm ADDED alongside the sealed 1-em arm (laptop M12), before any arm-B read.
